The Inter-Agency Task Force on Coastal Environment
Protection
(IATFCEP) of Region I in coordination
with the Lingayen Gulf Coastal Area
Management
Commission
(LGCAMC) and the Local Govemment
shall dismantle
the illegal fishpens and fishcages within the municipal
and rivers of the Lingayen Gulf.
A Comprehensive
Coastal Development
Plan (CCDP) shall be
by the concemed
The concerned
LGUs should
enact a Municipal/City
Fishery Ordinance
based on the CCDP to regulate the
operation of fishpens and fishcages.

The Department
of Environment
and Natural Resources (DENR)
shall provide the initial operational
fund requirement
to One Million
The Department
of Agriculture
(DA), Department
of Interi<tr and
Government
(DILG) , Philippine
Department
of National
Defense (DND) shall provide One Million
each for the full implementation
of this Order.
This Executive
Order shall take effect immediately
remain in full force until the above-stated tasks shall have been attained.
DONE in the City of Manila, this
of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Seven.
By the President:
